P0_A_performance_discrepancy.diagnosis: Leaf roughness in surface_plants.rs was 0.56, strictly below ROUGHNESS_CUTOFF=0.60 in ray_scene.rs. Every foliage fragment on 3,830,600 triangles evaluated rt_reflection with 2-bounce hardware ray queries, spending 1,096 ms in render.scene_classify_and_raster.
P0_A_performance_discrepancy.remedy: Set foliage roughness to 0.65 in surface_plants.rs. Realistic matte/satiny organic cuticle avoids triggering mirror ray queries while preserving GGX sun specular highlights and sky reflection.

P0_B_suspicious_contact_ao.diagnosis: Unphysical coupling of direct stellar cascade shadow to indirect ambient illuminance, violating Invariant I-05 and causing double-darkening in shadows.
P0_B_suspicious_contact_ao.remedy: Removed expression from shaders.rs. Direct stellar shadow visibility and indirect ambient sky illuminance are strictly separated.

P0_C_hydrology_and_coordinate_drift.diagnosis: Procedural ground depressions previously used camera-relative input.render_position, which drifted across the ground when camera translated.
P0_C_hydrology_and_coordinate_drift.remedy: Replaced with body-fixed chart_offset * bitcast<f32>(params.radius_bits). Preserves planetary precision (I-04) and canonical physical authority (I-01).

P0_D_thin_foliage_energy.optical_model: Two-sided diffuse transmission obeying (1-T)*max(N.L,0) + T*max(-N.L,0) modulated by (1 - F) and Albedo <= 1.0.

P0_E_grazing_normal_conditioning.diagnosis: Ad-hoc specular_normal projection eye_nv < 0.0 was redundant with existing smoothstep falloff in surface_sun_reflection.
P0_E_grazing_normal_conditioning.remedy: Removed redundant normal mutation in shaders.rs.

P0_F_taa_effectiveness.diagnosis: Plant meshes write static alpha=1.0 and reproject via camera motion. However, subpixel foliage edges cause temporal depth disocclusion.
P0_F_taa_effectiveness.remedy: Documented limitation. Subpixel foliage stability requires geometric LOD coverage.
